retained_natural_comparison.evidence_scope: Previously executed natural games. Their initial-state distribution differs from the fixed acceptance roots; horizon effects and root-distribution effects must not be conflated.

evidence_scope: Candidate minus incumbent on fixed V78 roots, seeds, models and prefixes. Full utility is truncated whenever an outcome is CUTOFF; such a stage has no hypothetical terminal acceptance verdict. Lifecycle means are the independent replication summaries. Paired trajectory sign changes are descriptive, not independent statistical replications. Hypothetical full acceptance does not alter V78 model adoption.
